title: High-protein snacks gain consumer interest
text: Indian consumers are increasingly interested in convenient high-protein snacks and healthier alternatives.

title: Low-sugar beverages attract wellness consumers
text: Consumers are showing increased interest in low-sugar functional beverages with hydration and wellness benefits.

title: Consumers request more convenient healthy meals
text: Consumer feedback indicates growing demand for convenient meal options that still provide nutritional value.

title: Natural ingredients become more important
text: Consumers increasingly examine ingredient lists and prefer products using recognizable natural ingredients.

title: Fitness consumers prioritize recovery nutrition
text: Active consumers increasingly look for products supporting post-workout recovery and protein intake.

title: Sustainable packaging receives more attention
text: Consumers are paying more attention to packaging waste and environmentally responsible product choices.
